Metadata.title: BMQT · Quality & Traceability
Metadata.description: A secure synthetic manufacturing quality and traceability workspace.

HomePage.title: Battery Manufacturing Quality & Traceability System
HomePage.description: The modern frontend foundation is being prepared for multilingual Project 2 workflows.

Shell.logoutError: Sign out could not be completed. Your authenticated session remains active.

overview.title: Overview
overview.stateDescription: Dashboard and traceability capabilities will be introduced in Phase 4. No manufacturing metrics are shown until they are backed by the synthetic application data model.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.description: Product genealogy and manufacturing history workspace.
traceability.stateDescription: Search is available now. Unit detail and genealogy remain part of the next Phase 4 subphase.

production.title: Production
production.description: Manufacturing recording workspace for authorized production users.
production.stateTitle: Production workflows are not implemented yet
production.stateDescription: This route currently validates role-aware navigation only. It does not contain forms, records, or simulated operations.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.description: Quality inspection workspace for authorized quality users.
inspections.stateTitle: Inspection workflows are not implemented yet
inspections.stateDescription: Inspection entry and evidence history remain in a later domain phase. No inspection records are simulated here.

nonconformance.title: Nonconformance
nonconformance.description: Nonconformance workflow access for authorized production and quality users.
nonconformance.stateTitle: Nonconformance workflows are not implemented yet
nonconformance.stateDescription: Cases, actions, and dispositions remain in a later domain phase. No records or counts are fabricated here.

actions.title: Engineering Actions
actions.description: Engineering action workspace for authorized engineering users.
actions.stateTitle: Engineering actions are not implemented yet
actions.stateDescription: This placeholder proves the application-shell boundary without creating fake action records or controls.

users.title: Users
users.description: User administration workspace for authorized administrators.
users.stateTitle: User administration is not implemented yet
users.stateDescription: Account management remains a future capability. This page does not expose internal identities or security metadata.

unavailable.title: Workspace unavailable
unavailable.description: This destination is not available for your authenticated role.
unavailable.stateDescription: Navigation visibility improves usability only. Server-side authorization remains authoritative for every protected operation.

trace.title: Trace a unit
trace.description: Enter one synthetic trace code to continue into the traceability workspace.
trace.label: Trace code
trace.invalid: Enter 1–128 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
trace.help: Trace codes are normalized to uppercase.

states.errorTitle: Unable to load the operational overview
states.errorDescription: The dashboard service could not be reached. Try again to request current evidence.
states.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not have permission to view the operational dashboard.

quality.title: Inspection outcomes
quality.scopeAllRecords: Counts cover all persisted inspection records. No yield rate is inferred.
quality.unavailable: Inspection evidence is currently unavailable; no zero value is implied.

models.title: Packs by product model
models.empty: No persisted product-model pack evidence is available.

nonconformance.title: Active case context
nonconformance.context: These lifecycle counts do not represent every quality failure and do not establish an overall quality status.

activity.title: Recent manufacturing activity
activity.empty: No process execution activity is available.

TraceabilitySearch.title: Find a traceable unit
TraceabilitySearch.description: Browse persisted synthetic units or narrow the evidence by trace code, unit type, and direct product model.

form.traceHelp: Optional exact or prefix search. Trace codes are normalized to uppercase.
form.traceInvalid: Enter no more than 128 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
form.unitTypeHelp: Includes packs, modules, cells, components, and materials.
form.productModelHelp: Optional direct product-model filter; it does not infer descendant models.
form.productModelInvalid: Enter no more than 64 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

samples.description: These curated portfolio records demonstrate distinct traceability and quality histories.
samples.behavior: Selecting a sample fills only the trace-code input. Review the existing filters, then choose Search.

cleanPass.title: Clean PASS
cleanPass.description: Connected genealogy, completed process evidence, and PASS inspections.

ngRetest.title: NG followed by PASS retest
ngRetest.description: The original NG remains beside its correction, retest, verification, and later PASS evidence.

escalated.title: Escalated NC and rework
escalated.description: An abnormal case, escalation, component replacement, retest, verification, and dispositions.

states.emptyDescription: Adjust or clear the current trace code and filters to search again.
states.pageEmptyDescription: Return to a previous page to review the available matching units.
states.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not have permission to search traceability evidence.
states.invalidDescription: Review the trace code, filters, and page values before trying again.
states.serverDescription: The traceability service could not complete the request. Try again.
states.networkDescription: Check the service connection and try the search again.
states.unexpectedDescription: The response could not be safely displayed. Try again.

search.title: Search another traceable unit
search.description: Start a new trace-code search without leaving the traceability workflow.
search.label: Trace code
search.help: The search opens the existing Traceability results workspace.
search.invalid: Enter 1–128 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

identity.description: Persisted identity and direct product context for this traceable unit.

evidence.title: Available records
evidence.description: Counts confirm directly stored evidence only. They do not establish unit health, completion, or a quality outcome.

genealogy.title: Genealogy
genealogy.description: Review bounded persisted parent and child evidence, then open a related unit to continue tracing.
genealogy.ancestorsDescription: Current context is bounded to eight levels. Historical paths remain separate evidence paths.
genealogy.descendantsDescription: One direct level is shown by default. Open a related unit to continue downward.
genealogy.noAncestors: No parent relationship evidence exists in the selected scope.
genealogy.noDescendants: No child relationship evidence exists in the selected scope.
genealogy.loadMoreError: More relationships could not be loaded. Existing evidence remains visible; try again.

partial.EDGE_LIMIT: More relationships are available. Use Load more to continue.
partial.DEPTH_LIMIT: Additional relationships exist beyond the requested depth. Open a related unit to continue tracing.

genealogy.cycleWarning: A cyclic relationship path was detected and safely omitted. The remaining evidence is still shown.

scope.label: Genealogy scope
scope.historicalNotice: Historical evidence includes current and removed relationships. The returned paths are lineage evidence and do not imply that every relationship was active at the same time.
scope.atHelp: Enter local time as DD/MM/YYYY, HH:mm. It is sent as one timezone-qualified instant.
scope.atRequired: Enter a complete date and time as DD/MM/YYYY, HH:mm before requesting as-of genealogy.

relationship.asOfExplanation: This relationship was active at the selected instant and was removed later.

process.title: Manufacturing history
process.description: Directly recorded process executions for this unit. This history is independent of the selected Genealogy scope.
process.empty: No process execution evidence is recorded directly for this unit.

quality.title: Quality history
quality.description: Directly recorded inspections for this unit. Inspection outcomes do not represent nonconformance lifecycle state and are independent of the Genealogy scope.
quality.empty: No quality inspection evidence is recorded directly for this unit.
quality.emptyFiltered: No directly recorded inspections match the selected {filter} filter.

nonconformance.title: Nonconformance history
nonconformance.description: Nonconformance records recorded directly for this unit. Current lifecycle state is separate from inspection outcome and is not affected by Genealogy scope.
nonconformance.empty: No nonconformance evidence is recorded directly for this unit.
nonconformance.emptyFiltered: No directly recorded nonconformances match the selected status.
nonconformance.partialNotice: Only a bounded portion of persisted evidence is displayed.
nonconformance.noneRecorded: No records are present in this evidence group.

errors.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not have permission to view this history.
errors.invalidDescription: The requested history page or filter could not be accepted.
errors.serverDescription: This history section could not be loaded. Other unit evidence remains visible.
errors.networkDescription: Check the service connection and retry this history section.
errors.unexpectedDescription: This history response could not be safely displayed. Other unit evidence remains visible.
errors.integrityDescription: Stored history could not be displayed safely.

states.invalidRouteDescription: Use 1–128 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores in the unit URL.
states.notFoundDescription: No persisted traceable unit matches this canonical trace code.
states.forbiddenTitle: Unit detail access is not available
states.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not have permission to view this traceability evidence.
states.invalidTitle: The unit detail request is invalid
states.invalidDescription: The trace code could not be accepted by the traceability service.
states.serverDescription: The traceability service could not complete the request. Try again.
states.networkDescription: Check the service connection and try loading the unit again.
states.unexpectedDescription: The response could not be safely displayed. Try again.
states.forbiddenGenealogyDescription: Your authenticated role does not have permission to view genealogy evidence.
states.invalidGenealogyDescription: Review the selected genealogy scope and time.
states.serverGenealogyDescription: This relationship direction is temporarily unavailable. Other unit evidence remains visible.
states.networkGenealogyDescription: Check the service connection and retry this relationship direction.
states.unexpectedGenealogyDescription: This relationship response could not be safely displayed. Other unit evidence remains visible.

foundation.title: Inspection entry foundation is ready
foundation.description: Secure API contracts, recovery state, and localization are prepared. Unit and specification selection will be introduced in the next subphase.

unit.title: Confirm a traceable unit
unit.description: Enter an exact public trace code before choosing an inspection specification.
unit.help: Use 1–128 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. Input is normalized to uppercase.

notFound.title: Unit not found
notFound.description: No traceable unit matches this exact code. The entered code has been preserved.

forbidden.title: Unit access unavailable
forbidden.description: Your authenticated role cannot read this unit.

network.title: Unable to reach traceability
network.description: Check the connection and try this unit again.

server.title: Unit lookup unavailable
server.description: The traceability service could not complete the lookup.

unexpected.title: Unexpected unit response
unexpected.description: The response could not be displayed safely.

discovery.title: Matching published specifications
discovery.compatibility: These published specifications match the unit type. Final unit, process, route, and execution compatibility remains server-authoritative at submission.
discovery.emptyDescription: Adjust the optional filters or confirm another unit.

notFound.title: Specifications unavailable
notFound.description: No published specification was found for this request.

forbidden.title: Discovery access unavailable
forbidden.description: Your role cannot discover inspection specifications.

network.title: Unable to reach specification discovery
network.description: Check the connection and try again.

server.title: Specification discovery unavailable
server.description: The service could not complete discovery.

unexpected.title: Unexpected discovery response
unexpected.description: The response could not be displayed safely.

criteria.title: Exact-version inspection criteria
criteria.serverAuthority: Displayed criteria guide evidence entry; the backend remains authoritative for the final PASS/NG outcome.
criteria.name: Canonical name

numeric.title: Numeric acceptance criteria
numeric.inclusive: Configured lower and upper bounds are inclusive.

visual.title: Visual options
visual.textOnly: Choose from these configured textual options later; no image upload is required.

text.title: Text evidence
text.requirement: Text evidence requires a nonblank observation and an explicit inspector PASS/NG outcome.

errors.notFound: This exact published version is no longer available.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot read this specification.
errors.network: The service could not be reached.
errors.server: The service could not load these criteria.
errors.unexpected: The response could not be displayed safely.

execution.title: Optional process execution
execution.description: Link an existing execution for this unit only when its public process and route context match the selected specification.
execution.empty: No matching executions are present on the loaded history pages.

errors.notFound: No process history was found for this unit.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot read process history.
errors.network: The service could not be reached.
errors.server: The service could not load process history.
errors.unexpected: The response could not be displayed safely.

evidence.title: Inspection evidence
evidence.description: Enter evidence for the selected exact specification. This page does not calculate an authoritative outcome.

timestamp.label: Inspection occurrence time
timestamp.help: Enter local wall-clock time in {zone} as DD/MM/YYYY, HH:mm. Review shows the explicit UTC serialization; the server enforces the future-time limit.
timestamp.invalid: Enter a complete valid date and time as DD/MM/YYYY, HH:mm.
timestamp.pickerLegend: Choose inspection occurrence date and time

review.title: Review inspection draft
review.description: Confirm this unsent draft. Frontend validation does not guarantee backend compatibility or acceptance.
review.noPrediction: No PASS/NG prediction is made for this evidence. The backend will remain authoritative.
review.textOutcomeInput: Inspector-provided TEXT outcome: {outcome}. This is input evidence, not a server-confirmed result.
review.noSubmit: Submission and authoritative result behavior remain unavailable in this subphase.
review.confirmation: Submitting confirms this reviewed public envelope. The backend will validate compatibility and determine the authoritative result.

validation.summary: Review the highlighted evidence and occurrence time before continuing.
validation.INVALID_DECIMAL: Use a plain decimal string without exponent notation or surrounding whitespace.
validation.DECIMAL_OUT_OF_RANGE: The value must fit DECIMAL(18,6), including at most 12 significant integer digits and 6 fractional digits.
validation.INVALID_OPTION: Choose an option owned by this exact specification version.
validation.TEXT_TOO_LONG: Text evidence must contain no more than 4,000 Unicode characters.
validation.OUTCOME_REQUIRED: Choose PASS or NG for TEXT evidence.
validation.TYPE_MISMATCH: The evidence type no longer matches the selected specification.

submission.uncertain: The submission outcome is uncertain. Recover or explicitly abandon it before starting another logical submission.
submission.deterministicFailure: The server returned a definite failure. Your evidence remains available so you can return to review it.

errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Review the inspection request and try again.
errors.INVALID_TYPED_RESULT: The evidence does not match the selected specification.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.TRACE_UNIT_NOT_FOUND: The traceable unit was not found.
errors.INSPECTION_SPECIFICATION_NOT_FOUND: The exact specification version was not found.
errors.INSPECTION_SPECIFICATION_NOT_PUBLISHED: The exact specification version is no longer published.
errors.INCOMPATIBLE_INSPECTION_CONTEXT: The unit, specification, or execution context is incompatible.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This recovery key belongs to a different logical submission.
errors.INSPECTION_WRITE_CONFLICT: The inspection could not be written safely. Retry the same submission.
errors.INSPECTION_PERSISTENCE_ERROR: The inspection service could not persist the submission.
errors.network: The service could not be reached. The outcome may be uncertain.
errors.malformed: The service confirmed success with a response that could not be displayed safely. The outcome remains uncertain; retry with the same recovery key.
errors.recovery: Safe recovery storage is unavailable. The inspection was not sent.
errors.unexpected: The inspection request could not be completed safely.

recovery.title: Unresolved inspection submission
recovery.description: A previous submission may have reached the server. Retry it with the same recovery key or explicitly abandon it.
recovery.expired: The saved recovery record is no longer available.
recovery.abandonWarning: Abandoning removes local recovery for this unresolved request. It does not prove that the server did not record the inspection.

upcoming.title: Inspection entry workflow
upcoming.description: Review, submit, recover uncertain outcomes, and use the server-confirmed result.

accessibility.draftRestored: Your unsent inspection draft was restored after the language change.
